decisions.reason: The accelerator program is cheap to run and still shown on the home page; it keeps options on many green startups open while their prospects remain uncertain.

The CO2-negative bitumen binder still has its own page and highly uncertain but potentially large upside in road construction, so the low-cost option is worth holding as the firm's portfolio narrows after dropping D.
The WASTX Cleanic is featured on the home page as the lead of the ERMAFA partnership, and the commitment has deepened across both years, so the firm should keep it and invest further.
